info.title: Church Management API
info.description: The church management API. Every request goes to a church's own host, for example https://grace-assembly.yourapp.com/api/v1. Amounts are GHS decimal strings with a _formatted sibling. Enum fields come with a _label sibling.

AddDepartmentMemberRequest.description: Validates adding a member to a department. The member must belong to this church.
AddDepartmentMemberRequest.title: AddDepartmentMemberRequest

CaptureVisitorRequest.description: Validates a visitor: a name, and optionally a phone number (normalised before it is checked) and how they heard of the church.
CaptureVisitorRequest.title: CaptureVisitorRequest

EducationalLevel.description: The allowed educational level values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
EducationalLevel.title: EducationalLevel

EraseMemberRequest.description: Validates an erasure request. The reason is kept in the change log, so it must not contain personal details.
EraseMemberRequest.title: EraseMemberRequest

FamilyRole.description: The allowed family role values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
FamilyRole.title: FamilyRole

Gender.description: The allowed gender values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
Gender.title: Gender

MaritalStatus.description: The allowed marital status values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MaritalStatus.title: MaritalStatus

MemberStatus.description: The allowed member status values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MemberStatus.title: MemberStatus

MembershipType.description: The allowed membership type values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MembershipType.title: MembershipType

MilestoneType.description: The allowed milestone type values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
MilestoneType.title: MilestoneType

PaymentMethod.description: The allowed payment method values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod

PledgeStatus.description: The allowed pledge status values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
PledgeStatus.title: PledgeStatus

QrCheckInRequest.description: Validates confirming a QR check-in: the scanned code, the phone number and the texted code.
QrCheckInRequest.title: QrCheckInRequest

RecordAttendanceRequest.description: Validates marking a list of members present at a service. The list is capped so one request stays small.

method.description: Only a manual check-in comes through here; QR and WhatsApp have their own entrances.

RecordAttendanceRequest.title: RecordAttendanceRequest

RegisterChurchRequest.description:
Validates the sign-up of a new church: its name, web address, member number prefix, first admin and the
code texted to that admin's phone.
RegisterChurchRequest.title: RegisterChurchRequest

RequestChurchOtpRequest.description: Validates the request to text a sign-up code to the phone of the person starting a church.
RequestChurchOtpRequest.title: RequestChurchOtpRequest

RequestOtpRequest.description: Validates a request to be sent a sign-in code.
RequestOtpRequest.title: RequestOtpRequest

RequestQrCheckinOtpRequest.description: Validates asking for a check-in code: the scanned code and the member's phone number.
RequestQrCheckinOtpRequest.title: RequestQrCheckinOtpRequest

ServiceType.description: The allowed service type values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).
ServiceType.title: ServiceType

SetServiceCheckinRequest.description: Validates opening or closing a service for check-in.
SetServiceCheckinRequest.title: SetServiceCheckinRequest

StoreContributionRequest.description:
Validates a cash gift. Everything it points at must belong to this church; a member who has died cannot be given
a new gift, and a fund that was switched off cannot be chosen. Only cash is recorded here: mobile money and cards
start a payment instead and are recorded when the provider confirms it.

payment_method.description: The allowed payment method values, stored as a plain string column (D-017).

StoreContributionRequest.title: StoreContributionRequest

StoreFamilyRequest.description: Validates a new family. An optional head must be an existing member of this church.
StoreFamilyRequest.title: StoreFamilyRequest

StoreMemberRequest.description: Validates a new member. The route's policy check has already run, so authorize() lets it through.
StoreMemberRequest.title: StoreMemberRequest

StoreMilestoneRequest.description: Validates a new milestone (baptism, confirmation, ...). It cannot be dated in the future.
StoreMilestoneRequest.title: StoreMilestoneRequest

StorePledgeRequest.description:
Validates a new pledge. The member and fund must belong to this church; a member who has died cannot make a pledge,
a fund that was switched off cannot be chosen, and the target date cannot be in the past.
StorePledgeRequest.title: StorePledgeRequest

StoreServiceRequest.description: Validates a new service. The check-in code is never accepted here: the system makes it.
StoreServiceRequest.title: StoreServiceRequest

UpdateFamilyRequest.description:
Validates a family update. The head is changed through the members' roles, not here, so two people
can never both hold the head role.
UpdateFamilyRequest.title: UpdateFamilyRequest

UpdateFundTypeRequest.description: Validates a fund type update. Any subset of fields may be sent. Setting is_active to false switches the fund off.
UpdateFundTypeRequest.title: UpdateFundTypeRequest

UpdateMemberStatusRequest.description: Validates a status change. The note is the reason kept in the change log.
UpdateMemberStatusRequest.title: UpdateMemberStatusRequest

UpdatePledgeRequest.description:
Validates a pledge update. Any of the description, amount and target date may be sent. The member and fund cannot
change, because gifts are linked to them (D-047).
UpdatePledgeRequest.title: UpdatePledgeRequest

UpdateServiceRequest.description:
Validates changes to a service. Any subset of the fields may be sent. A manual headcount stands in for the
digital count when a church counts heads on paper.
UpdateServiceRequest.title: UpdateServiceRequest

UploadMemberPhotoRequest.description:
Validates a member photo upload: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB and 4096 pixels on a side (docs/08).
The file type is read from the file's contents, not from its name or the Content-Type header.
The pixel limit also bounds the memory needed to decode it.
UploadMemberPhotoRequest.title: UploadMemberPhotoRequest

VoidContributionRequest.description: Validates a void. A reason is required, so every void can be explained later (docs/04, Corrections and Voids).
VoidContributionRequest.title: VoidContributionRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
